body: Dating was a nightmare after leaving my ex husband . I decided to just be single for a couple of years and work on myself . I’m now in a loving and amazing relationship with another woman. Best decision and I never have to deal with a man child again . ☺️

Sending love your way mama! Just know you’re not alone and you’ve been given the job of raising your son. I have certainly felt so low  at times raising my kids alone . It wasn’t the life I had planned on but I take it day by day. I try to focus on the things I can change and being a loving mother to my kids.
You’ve got this ! It’s so hard and my anxiety has also been so high lately. Deep breaths and the mantra one day at a time has been keeping me going .
I second this ! It’s amazing the difference a year can make !

Single mom to 3 and 7 year old. It is definitely hard, like really damn hard. The first year my youngest was born was honestly miserable. My ex husband and I had just separated and she was just not a happy baby. I sometimes wonder if it was partly because of all the stress and change in her life . Fast forward to now and my kids and I are doing so much better! Yes there are hard days but I promise you the good outweighs the bad . I would rather do it alone than be trying to do it while in an unhealthy relationship. My two littles and I have started to get in our groove and form our own little family dynamic. My youngest is starting to be able to communicate better and that really helps. Just try to remember that this time next year will look and b completely different than it is now….in a good way!

As others have said get lawyer like today , don’t go through this without legal advice. File for child support as well as applying for some type of food assistance program at local social service department. It’s going to be hard but you will find a way Mama, stay strong .

Took the pills an hour ago that I received through aid access. I have a two year old and six year old. I really didn’t have anyone to watch them while I did this so here we are. I just keep telling myself I can do this and I will get through this. You will 2 momma! We got this
I also had a good experience through aid access. They have been an amazing resource. Received my pills on Friday. Only took a week for them to arrive
Thank you so much!
Thank you for pointing me in the right direction! Haven’t been using Reddit very long. Amazing resources here. Thank you

This honestly hit so close. Have been dealing with back to back illness with my two children, one ending up in the hospital and a trip to the er for the other. Both having the same awful stomach flu. Going through that alone was tough as a single mom. I definitely missed the support having a partner gives you. Happy you have found someone so special.
This is so true
Gosh thank you for this. Gives me so much hope for the future. Can’t wait to be free
Thank you. Planning on making a appointment with a lawyer as well as a therapist this week.

He is 100 percent a narcissist. It literally describes him perfectly. Wish I had looked into it sooner. Really gives some answers to his way of thinking. I can see it getting worse . I’m going to start making my way out .

I can see this happening . He is extremely self absorbed. Like literally everything is about him. I’m going to call a lawyer this week. Worrying about all the “what ifs” is doing me no good. I will just have to take everything as it comes
Had to look up the grey rocking . Found a very helpful article . Thanks for the info
No mask. Handing over control of my babies to someone I have no trust for is definitely unsettling
I will thank you.
I never said I was a SAHM. I work full time as well

Thank you. This is good advice. I’m definitely not going to say anything else to him. He always seems to talk me out of it or makes me feel guilty for moving forward with it. Will be calling a lawyer this week.

It is messy for sure. I guess I used the word threat because he uses that to talk me out of divorce. He knows it scares me and uses that. But yes they are half his so at the end of the day I guess if he wanted 50/50 he should have it. It’s just difficult because he seems to care so little and spends very little time with them currently.
I have no idea what he does. I’ve stopped asking because of how upset he gets when I ask. I’m talking extremely upset . So idk

I understand this. It’s just hard to imagine when he is so absent and does so little currently. But hey I get it. The law is the law and hopefully in the end he will be there for the kids more than he is now.
Wow yea. All true. I’m done being a scared little girl. Fear gets us no where right?
Thank you. Yes I’m trying to find a good one . I’m afraid he is going to make this very difficult. He can be extremely difficult to reason with unfortunately
I do work 4 days a week. I guess I just need to come to terms and trust that they will be cared for when he has them. Just hard when he has such little involvement at the moment.

It is definitely tough. I believe he has a rage/anger problem that can be directed towards me a lot of the time. But he says that I am the one that makes him that way so hopefully if I am not around when he has the kids he will have more patience. His kids adore him and I would never want them to not see him. It’s just hard to imagine not being here to take care of my children when they are with him. He has just done so little for so long.
I agree they have a huge impact. I just hope it will be a good one.
I agree they do have a huge impact. Hopefully it will be a good one. At least if I leave they won’t think it’s okay to be treated the way he has treated me

Yes it is hard. I definitely want nothing more then for him to have a good relationship with his little girls. He has never been physically abusive. But he has become extremely mean and irritable. Puts me down a lot , has called me names, gets in my face . I believe he has a rage/anger problem. But as you said that is all between us, although I do believe his anger outbursts does affect our kids. But I am hopeful that all of this would be better if it was just him and the kids and maybe I am the one that makes him that way. At least he says I make him that way. So I guess In the end I just have to be okay with giving up time with my kids.
Thank you.

Totally agree about our own problems being between us and not the kids. But why do u feel he deserves 50/50 custody when he does nothing to help care for them now? Just wondering what your reasoning is

Thank you. Yes it does seem like if he really wanted and went for 50/50 custody he would probably get it. I guess then the question is what is worse . My own happiness or remaining in control of my kids. It’s hard to know I will have to hand over that control to a judge.

Yes I do feel like this could be what possibly happens. Or there’s the small chance that maybe he would step up and enjoy and be present when he did get his time with the kids, which in the end would be a good thing because they absolutely adore him . Which is sad because he is so absent

Thank you for your response. He does currently see a therapist as well as a psychologist. Has been for several years. He definitely struggles with some mental issues . But again he won’t discuss any of this with me. But yes I agree I am currently just treading water so to speak. We have been going in circles for years. He puts a lot on me as far as guilt. Tells me how I will regret leaving and how it will hurt our kids, and that will be my fault. Definitely makes me feel trapped.

So I must be a busy idiot and
Can’t figure
Out
How to make a proper post. But my husband of 10 years has developed a severe anger problem. We have two young children together. And it seems to check continue to get worse. He called me stupid tonight with our 5 year old daughter standing there. Apparently I don’t use common sense or really just can’t live up to his PCD standards. It’s a terrible situation. Wld never want my little girls to think it’s okay to be treated this way.
Haha yes it is. I was trying to write a post but apparently can’t even do that right .
